software_class: automation workflow across tools, approvals, and repetitive operations

options.name: API orchestration workflow
options.when_to_use: Systems expose stable APIs and clear auth boundaries.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when required systems lack API access.
options.tradeoffs: Depends on API coverage and quotas.

options.name: Human-in-loop automation
options.when_to_use: Approvals or review are required before action.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when fully deterministic automation is safe.

options.name: Desktop RPA workflow
options.when_to_use: No stable API exists and UI automation is the only route.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when API or export integration is available.
options.risks: Credentials and unattended execution are risks.
